description.p: NetWatch continuously checks your internet connection, detects outages, measures latency and packet loss, and keeps a local history you can explore and export. Everything stays on your computer: no account, cloud service or subscription.

ul.li: Distinguishes “no internet” from “not connected” and from times NetWatch was not running
Outage history with calendar heat map, event timeline and searchable event log
Latency and packet loss charts per target
Subtle sound alerts and desktop notifications
TXT, CSV and HTML reports suitable for support requests
Keeps monitoring in the background, with an optional status icon
